title: Find central formal charge
hints: Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
statement:
What is formal charge on O in $\ce{H3O+}$ with three O–H bonds and one oxygen lone pair?

[_]{a}

explanations: One lone pair is two electrons and three bonds assign three electrons.
This subtracts one electron for a lone pair.
This fails to account for the cation charge.
